motion.name: Motion 9: Examples of Anti-Palestinian Racism (APR)
introduction: Anti-Palestinian Racism (APR) comprises actions, inactions, narratives, or structures that target Palestinians or deny their identity, history, and rights. It includes the targeting or penalisation of supporters.
This PSC AGM resolves to recognise these non-exhaustive examples of APR, consistent with accepted equality and human rights norms.

examples.category: Erasure and denial of ethnic or indigenous identity
examples.text: Using the phrase ‘a land without people for a people without a land’ to deny Palestinian indigeneity in historic Palestine.

examples.category: Erasure and denial of ethnic or indigenous identity
Erasure and denial of ethnic or indigenous identity
examples.text: Failing to acknowledge Palestinians as an indigenous people with a collective identity, belonging, and rights in historic Palestine.
Erasing Palestinians’ human rights, equal dignity, and worth.
examples.classification: direct discrimination; dehumanisation; harassment; interference with identity

examples.text: Defaming Palestinians or their allies as inherently antisemitic, a terrorist threat or sympathisers, or opposed to democratic values.
examples.classification: direct discrimination; harassment; restriction on expression
dehumanisation; direct discrimination; incitement to violence; failure to protect

examples.category: Exclusion and suppression of Palestinian participation
examples.text: Requiring Palestinians or supporters to denounce acts more vociferously or holding them collectively responsible for others’ acts.
examples.classification: direct discrimination; harassment; restriction on expression

examples.category: Exclusion and suppression of Palestinian participation
examples.text: Excluding Palestinian perspectives, Palestinians, or their allies, or pressuring others to do so.
examples.classification: direct discrimination; harassment; restriction on participation

examples.category: Exclusion and suppression of Palestinian participation
examples.text: Politicians and officials failing to engage with Palestinian victims of war crimes or racism while engaging with other racial groups.

examples.category: Unequal application of legal, political and humanitarian standards
examples.text: Denying, delaying, or undermining recognition of Palestine as a state while supporting recognition of Israel.
examples.classification: structural discrimination; impairment of collective rights; restriction on participation

examples.category: Unequal application of legal, political and humanitarian standards
examples.text: Calling for a safe and secure Israel but not for Palestinian safety and security.
examples.classification: direct discrimination; failure to protect; humanitarian neglect

examples.category: Unequal application of legal, political and humanitarian standards
examples.text: Denying Palestinian refugees and their descendants the right of return under international law.

examples.category: Unequal application of legal, political and humanitarian standards
examples.text: Not applying the same international law standards to Palestinians as to other groups.
The systems of apartheid imposed on Palestinians, supporting these systems, or denying or minimising their existence against the overwhelming evidence.
Promoting or excusing extremist settler ideology, including hate or violence towards Palestinians, discriminatory laws, or theft of Palestinian land and resources.
examples.classification: direct discrimination; structural violence and discrimination; dispossession/theft

examples.text: The Balfour Declaration, by privileging one group on a religious basis, caused lasting harm to indigenous Palestinians by denying their rights and enabling colonisation.
Islamophobia and hatred targeting Palestinian Muslims, non-Muslim Palestinians perceived as Muslim, and other Muslims supporting Palestinian rights.

examples.category: Targeting supporters of Palestinian rights by association
examples.text: Targeting, vilifying, or penalising individuals for expressing solidarity with Palestinians, including treating support for Palestinian rights as suspect, extremist, or antisemitic by association.
examples.classification: direct discrimination; harassment; restriction on expression; racialisation by association
